article.story: CHARLOTTESVILLE, Va. -- — Chance Mallory had 16 points and six assists as No. 6 Virginia cruised to a 95-61 victory over Bucknell on Tuesday night. Thijs De Ridder added 15 points, eight rebounds, four assists and four steals for the unbeaten Cavaliers. Nolan Adekunle scored 14 on 5-of-6 shooting from the field — including 3 for 4 from 3-point range. Johann Grünloh finished with 13 points and a team-high nine boards. Those four starters had all reached double figures with 16 1/2 minutes remaining. Mallory had 13 points in the first half and finished 6 for 9 from the floor, including 3 of 5 on 3s. He capped the opening period with an impressive drive from the other end of the court to hit a layup and draw a foul with 0.4 seconds left. Aleksander Pachucki and Luke Soden scored 12 points apiece to lead the Bison. Virginia (4-0) scored the first 11 points and never looked back, extending its lead to 24 in the first half. Bucknell (0-3) called its first timeout with 10:08 to go before halftime. De Ridder then made it 14 straight Cavaliers points with a steal and one-handed dunk immediately out of the timeout. UVA led 53-31 at the break after going 21 for 37 from the field and 7 of 16 from beyond the arc. Bucknell was outrebounded 52-29 after entering last in Division I with 21 rebounds per game. Up next Bucknell hosts Columbia on Friday. Virginia visits Maryland on Friday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
